description: Single source of truth for all matchPattern() SC patterns. Each entry documents a pattern that the conformity engine can auto-test.

patterns.name: file-exists
patterns.notes: Checks file existence. Optional line count limit with ≤ N lines suffix.

patterns.name: directory-exists
patterns.notes: Checks directory existence. Supports aliases (test/tests, reference/ref). Optional minimum file count.

patterns.name: all-specs-frontmatter
patterns.notes: Verifies every spec in specs/ has valid YAML frontmatter with testable field. Scans one level deep.

patterns.name: paths-resolve
patterns.example: all paths referenced in AGENTS.md resolve
patterns.notes: Checks every markdown link in the file resolves to an existing path. Skips http and anchor links.

patterns.name: root-is-clean
patterns.notes: Limits root directory item count. Auto-detects code vs content projects for default threshold.

patterns.name: exists-with-pointer
patterns.example: CLAUDE.md exists with pointer to AGENTS.md
patterns.notes: Checks file exists AND contains the target string.

patterns.name: bun-test-passes
patterns.notes: Always passes (test suite execution is external). Placeholder for CI integration.

patterns.name: canary
patterns.notes: Checks that a conformity or canary test file exists in the test directory.

patterns.name: content-contains
patterns.notes: Verifies file contains every item in the bracket list. Items are comma-separated.

patterns.name: content-not-contains
patterns.notes: Verifies file does NOT contain any item in the bracket list. Supports both 'must NOT contain' and 'has no' syntax.

patterns.name: count-threshold
patterns.syntax: {subject} is under [{N}] lines | {subject} at most [{N}] words
patterns.notes: Checks file line or word count against threshold. Subject is treated as a file path.

patterns.name: json-field-equals
patterns.notes: Reads JSON file and checks field value. Supports nested fields with dot notation.

patterns.name: section-exists
patterns.notes: Checks markdown file has a heading matching the section name.

patterns.name: regex-match
patterns.notes: Tests file content against arbitrary regex. Flags are optional.

patterns.name: source-contains
patterns.notes: Like content-contains but scoped to source files (lib/, scripts/, hooks/, gates/). Triggered by 'harness' prefix or source path.

patterns.name: json-has-field
patterns.notes: Checks JSON file has a defined field. Supports nested fields with dot notation.

patterns.name: scaffold-produces
patterns.notes: Verifies scaffold output file exists in the project root.

patterns.name: frontmatter-field
patterns.notes: Checks YAML frontmatter field existence and optionally its value.

patterns.name: file-line-range
patterns.notes: Checks file line count falls within an inclusive range.
